To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the physical education curriculum in China is more focused on the basic skills and theory, while in the United States, the physical education curriculum emphasizes on the application of the basic skills and knowledge to the daily life and social life.

there are mainly the following differences: In the US, more attention is paid to cultivating students' independent exercising capability and creative capability,while in China, more attention is given to cultivating students' sports knowledge, skill learning capability and problem-solving capability;In the USA, more attention is showered on unifying and diversifying and combining theory with practice;in China, more attention was showerd on unification and practice than diversification and theory, and theory was not closely linked with practice;structually
the contents of physical and health education curriculum implemented in the institutes of higher learning of China and the United State are quite different.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the contents of physical exercise and health curriculum implemented by institutes of higher learning.
the differences in the contents of physical exercise and health education between China and the US.
the differences in the contents of physical and health education curriculum implemented in institutes for higher learning in China, and the United States.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the US physical education and health curricula were more advanced than those implemented in China.
the US curriculum was more advanced in its content and structure,more scientific and more practical,while the Chinese one was more simple in structure and less practical.

the US curriculum had a more comprehensive and detailed structure,while the Chinese one had a more simple and concise structure,which was more suitable to the needs of the Chinese students and the development of the physical education and health in China.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Chinese curriculum is more suitable for students' physical and health education and the US curriculum is more suitable to the needs of students' life and social development.

in terms of the contents of curriculum,the US curriculum was characterized by its scientific,reasonable and practical features,and it had a good foundation and was of great significance to the development of physical education in China.

the contents of physical and health education curriculum implemented in institutes higher learning in China should be reformed and improved from the following three aspects: First,we should make the contents of physical exercise and health education more closely combined with the needs for social life and adult life;second,we should make more emphasis on the cultivation of students' independent exercising capability and create capability;third,we should pay more attention to the combination between theory and practice and the combination between unification and diversifi-cation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the contents of physical curriculum in China should be improved in the following aspects: the contents of the physical education and health should be closely combined with the needs of adult life and social development;the curriculum should be arranged according to the fitness functions;the curriculum should pay attention to the cultivation of student's independent exercising and creating capability;the curriculum should emphasize the combination between theory and practice,and should be arranged in the light of the needs for the development of the whole society.
we should make full use of the advantages of the Chinese curriculum and learn the advantages of the US curriculum,so as to improve our curriculum.

the contents of physical exercise curriculum implemented in institutes should be based on the needs of adult life and social development,should be closely combined with the needs of the development of the country's economy,society and culture and with the needs of student's all-round development,should be arranged according to the needs of fitness functions,should be closely integrated with theory and practice,and should be closely combined with student's life and work.
